messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT: CatalystOne (tenant:catalystone) — elevated 5xx rate on /v1/generate; affected pool: dedicated-vpool-catalystone. Pager sent to SRE oncall.
Sam (SRE-oncall): reading it now. seeing a spike in token-emit errors + 504s from the dedicated pool. throwing up dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/tenants/catalystone/metrics
Maya (Customer Success - CatalystOne): catalyst support — customers reporting timeouts and partial responses in production flows. they're seeing higher latency and some truncated outputs.
Sam (SRE-oncall): rough error sample: `err=kv_cache_miss: invalidated-kv` + `model-exec-timeout` for model `redwood/large-3b#3.3.0` around 23:10 UTC. traffic ~ steady but errors ~ 7% of requests for that tenant.
Kim (Runtime Eng): I think this lines up with the rolling runtime rollout we did to improve KV eviction behavior. looks like the new kernel path mis-handles pinned KV on dedicated pools with long-lived sessions. hypothesis: new 3.3.0 variant triggers a fallback async path that times out.
Alex (PM): customer impact = degraded live inference quality + 5xx/timeouts. SLAs at risk if this persists. need mitigation ASAP and clear comms.
Sam (SRE-oncall): mitigation options: 1) apply tenant override to pin to known-good model version 3.2.1 (safe stable), 2) route traffic to the safe-variant (quantized/low-latency) we keep for such events, or 3) temporary capacity shift to a different dedicated host group. fastest is tenant override -> safe variant.
Kim (Runtime Eng): agree. safe-variant `redwood/large-3b@safe-latency-2025` is verified for CatalystOne with identical prompts; slightly lower quality but stable. I'll prepare override payload.
Sam (SRE-oncall): executing tenant override now. patching route via Admin API. command:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/internal/tenant-overrides \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{\n    \"tenant_id\": \"catalystone\",\n    \"override\": {\n      \"model_id\": \"redwood/large-3b@safe-latency-2025\",\n      \"pin\": true,\n      \"reason\": \"authed incident mitigation - pin safe variant during degradation\",\n      \"ttl_seconds\": 3600\n    }\n  }'
```
Sam (SRE-oncall): response: `200 OK` - override accepted. routing table shows 95% of new sessions hitting safe-variant within 12s.
Maya (Customer Success - CatalystOne): confirming with customer — they see immediate drop in errors, some lower BLEU on certain evals but acceptable for now. they want ETA for full fix.
Kim (Runtime Eng): I'll revert the runtime rollout on dedicated-vpool-catalystone and push a revert of the kernel selection patch. estimated 2-3 hours to test and redeploy. I'll also open a PR with improved unit tests for KV edgecases.
Alex (PM): good. communication plan: Maya/Jules to send interim status to customer: we've pinned to a safe variant and are actively rolling back a runtime change; we'll follow up with RCA and timeline.
Jules (Account Exec): I'll draft the customer note and schedule a 1:1 if they want.
Sam (SRE-oncall): handoff to night SRE @ 18:30 UTC. night oncall: Priya. key actions for handover: 1) monitor 5xx rate for catalystone and total TPS, 2) verify override TTL and extend if rollback not ready, 3) coordinate with Kim on runtime revert progress.
Sam (SRE-oncall): handoff note:
```
- current status: tenant pinned to safe-variant `redwood/large-3b@safe-latency-2025` (since 1769912345)
- last observed 5xx rate: 0.8% (down from 7%)
- outstanding: runtime revert in progress (PR #4521). watch for deploy-induced flaps.
- commands: `GET /v1/internal/tenant-overrides?tenant_id=catalystone` -> inspect override, `POST /v1/internal/tenant-overrides/extend` to bump TTL
```
Priya (SRE-night): acknowledged, on it. will extend TTL to 4h if Kim's revert needs more time. :white_check_mark:
Kim (Runtime Eng): starting rollback now — will coordinate in this thread. I'll run a small canary on one host first, then full rollback. I'll post logs and PR link when ready.
EVAL-bot: automated quality check ran against canonical prompt set: safe-variant perf delta: -3.2% BLEU (acceptable threshold 5%).
Maya (Customer Success - Catalyst-One): customer appreciated the instant fix. flagged for RCA and artifact timeline.
Alex (PM): post-incident actions: RCA doc, regression test addition (KV cache long-session tests), add explicit safe-variant playbook to oncall runbook. owner: Kim.
Sam (SRE-oncall): closing active page for now, monitoring for 30m then handoff complete. will update incident tracker `INC-2026-0923`. :lock:
Kim (Runtime Eng): PR #4521 reverted, canary looks clean, rolling full revert at +45m. will update timeline here.
Priya (SRE-night): extended TTL to 4h. I'll stand by and escalate if errors creep back up.
Maya (Customer Success - Catalyst-One): sending customer update now. thanks team. :pray:
